title: Refreshed Java and Bedrock compatibility
summary: A server update brings current Bedrock compatibility and a fix for furnace updates on Bedrock.
body:
- Updated the Java server engine to Paper 26.2 build 124.
- Updated Bedrock connectivity to Geyser 2.11.3 build 1240, supporting Bedrock 26.30–26.34, 26.40–26.45, 26.50 and 26.51.
- Included a Bedrock compatibility fix for furnace updates.
